name: Professional AI YouTube Shorts Studio (Full Google Pro Stack)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — sab kuch ek hi API key se

**1. API key (sirf YE ek chahiye):** [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) → `GEMINI_API_KEY`

**2. BILLING enable karo (zaroori!):** AI Studio → Billing → **Upgrade to Pay as you go**
⚠️ Google One AI Pro **subscription** API ke liye KaAM NAHI karta — subscription ka quota sirf Gemini app mein chalta hai. Veo / Pro TTS / Nano Banana Pro API se sirf billing enable karne pe chalte hain.

**3. JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY (free):** [json2video.com/get-api-key](https://json2video.com/get-api-key/) — Google ka video *stitching* API nahi hai, isliye final assembly ke liye ye free tool.

**4. Last node pe YouTube OAuth2 credential.**

### 💰 Approx cost per video (pay-as-you-go)
| Cheez | Cost |
|---|---|
| Veo 3.1 Fast 4 clips x 8s (720p) | ~$3.20 |
| Nano Banana Pro outro image | ~$0.15 |
| Gemini Pro TTS voiceover | ~$0.02 |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro script | free tier |
| **Total** | **~$3.4 / ₹290 per Short** |

Budget bachana ho to `VEO_MODEL` = `veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview` (~$1.60/video).

### 🎙️ Voices (Config mein badlo)
Male: **Fenrir** (default, energetic), Puck, Charon (informative) • Female: Kore (firm), Zephyr (bright), Aoede (breezy)

## 🎬 Professional Pipeline (All-Google generation)

**TOPIC → publish-ready Short, ~5-8 min:**

1. **Gemini 2.5 Pro** pura plan banata hai — title, description, tags, 4 scenes (hook + voiceover + karaoke captions + Veo prompt) + outro design prompt
2. **Gemini Pro TTS** har scene ka voiceover (24kHz WAV, natural narration)
3. **Veo 3.1** har scene ka cinematic 8s vertical (9:16) footage generate karta hai (parallel, 4 clips)
4. **Nano Banana Pro** branded outro background image banata hai
5. **JSON2Video** sab jodta hai: footage + voiceover + golden hook + word-by-word captions + FOLLOW outro (1080x1920)
6. Render complete hone tak auto-poll → MP4 download → **YouTube private upload**

### ⏱️ Timings
- Veo clips: 2-6 min (workflow khud poll karta hai)
- JSON2Video render: 1-3 min
- tmpfiles.org links ~60 min valid (audio/clips/outro hosting)

### ⚠️ Notes
- Video **private** upload hoti hai — review karke public karo
- Veo safety-filter block kare to Collector node clear error dega — topic/prompt thoda change karo
- JSON2Video free plan = 600 sec/month (is video size ke hisab se ok). Style tweak karna ho to `Build Movie JSON` node dekho
- Category: 27 (Education). Shorts ke liye #Shorts description mein add kar sakte ho
